description: Header file defining the fifo_async_task_scheduler class for managing asynchronous task scheduling, including methods for scheduling tasks, stopping the scheduler, and utility functions for task completion synchronization.

classes.name: fifo_async_task_scheduler
classes.description: Manages a queue of asynchronous tasks, executing them sequentially in a dedicated coroutine loop.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules an async_task or a callable with arguments for execution.

methods.name: clear_pending_tasks
methods.description: Clears all pending tasks in the queue.

methods.name: request_stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler by enqueuing a termination task.

methods.name: nof_pending_tasks
methods.description: Returns the number of pending tasks.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the task queue is empty.

methods.name: is_stopped
methods.description: Checks if the scheduler has been stopped.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Internal method that runs the main loop processing tasks.
